description: This script is a Node.js utility used for analyzing and validating extension plugin SDK boundary violations in a TypeScript/JavaScript codebase. It inspects source files to identify improper module imports or re-exports outside specified boundaries, generates inventories of violations, compares them to expected baselines, and outputs human-readable or JSON reports. The script primarily processes source files related to plugin extensions and enforces project-specific import rules.

methods.name: collectExtensionSourceFiles
methods.description: Recursively collects and filters source code files in the project directory that are not test files or in ignored directories.

methods.name: collectParsedExtensionSourceFiles
methods.description: Parses collected source files into TypeScript SourceFile objects asynchronously.

methods.name: resolveExtensionRoot
methods.description: Determines the extension root directory from a given file path.

methods.name: classifyReason
methods.description: Generates a human-readable reason string for why an import or export statement is considered a boundary violation based on mode and path.

methods.name: collectEntriesByModeFromSourceFile
methods.description: Analyzes a source file for module specifiers and categorizes violations according to project rules.

methods.name: collectExtensionPluginSdkBoundaryInventory
methods.description: Builds an inventory of boundary violations across all extension source files for a given mode.

methods.name: readExpectedInventory
methods.description: Reads the baseline expected violations JSON for a specific mode.

methods.name: diffInventory
methods.description: Calculates differences between expected and actual inventories.

methods.name: runExtensionPluginSdkBoundaryCheck
methods.description: Performs the boundary check and outputs the results in JSON or human-readable format, optionally comparing with baselines.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for executing the boundary check script directly.
